versions.changelog:
- Added Solcast integration through the OOMOL `oo` CLI with server-managed credentials.
- Supports irradiance and weather forecasts for coordinates up to 14 days ahead.
- Retrieves historical estimated actuals from 2007 through 7 days ago.
- Retrieves live estimated actuals covering the past 7 days.
- Uses live connector schemas to validate action inputs and JSON responses.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@75bac03`

- Provides read-only access to Solcast through the OOMOL `oo` connector without exposing raw API tokens.
- Supports irradiance and weather forecasts by latitude/longitude up to 14 days ahead.
- Retrieves historical estimated actuals from 2007 through 7 days ago.
- Fetches live estimated actuals for the previous 7 days.
- Guides users to inspect live action schemas before running connector calls.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@146ef20`

- Provides an OOMOL-connected Solcast skill for retrieving solar irradiance and weather data without handling raw API credentials.
- Supports latitude/longitude-based forecasts up to 14 days ahead via `get_radiation_and_weather_forecast`.
- Supports historical estimated actuals from 2007 through 7 days ago via `get_radiation_and_weather_historic`.
- Supports live estimated actuals for the past 7 days via `get_radiation_and_weather_live_estimated_actuals`.
- Includes action-level references and schema-first `oo connector` commands for reliable payload construction.
